steps.note: The ricotta is taken off as it floats and filled into baskets.
The cheeses are salted by sprinkling, on wooden boards in the cold room.
The ricotta is ripened on wooden boards in a cold room or a dry, cold cellar, for 120 days for buffalo ricotta and 30–90 days for sheep's.

links.name: Ricotta di bufala (salata, infornata, affumicata), PAT Lazio, in the Atlante dei prodotti tipici (ONAF)

sources.text: The steps and the 120 days of a Lazio buffalo-whey ricotta salata from the regional list of traditional products, and the 30–90 days and the pressing of the usual sheep's-whey ricotta salata from the second page; the two differ in whether it is pressed.
